column2: ReplaceWhen::Enters over a land an opponent puts onto the battlefield (a land played included) needs a ReplaceBy that keeps the entering and runs steps after it ("puts that land onto the battlefield then sacrifices a land of their choice"), with its condition read for the entering land's controller ("an opponent who controls at least as many lands as you do": Count of lands of ControllerOf the entering permanent against yours, before it enters); ReplaceBy::Instead with a Move to the battlefield would lose the land play
